title: Native Alchemy docs deployment tasks
beforeImplementation: Use the installed Alchemy 2.0.0-beta.64 and the current native Website.Vite graph. Keep Fumadocs generated MDX source shared across the TanStack client/server build environments. Preserve historical evidence and use only the named TaxKit deployment authority.
principles: Every provider and public claim is bound to an exact pushed commit and sanitised receipt.
Credentials remain outside source, logs and durable evidence.
A skipped proof layer is recorded as a non-claim rather than inferred from another layer.

tasks.title: Prove the exact candidate locally
acceptance: Focused deployment, docs and built Worker/browser checks pass.
Installed versions, base revision and local proof limits are recorded.

tasks.title: Commit, push and complete workflow bootstrap
acceptance: One exact candidate commit and trusted draft PR are read back.
The reviewed workflow source is present on main before provider dispatch.

tasks.title: Accept Preview
acceptance: Native one-resource plan and equal replan are accepted.
Provider readback, hosted journey and desktop/mobile screenshots pass.
Exact Preview teardown proves stage and Worker absence after Production.

tasks.title: Accept Production
acceptance: Production consumes the exact Preview-accepted candidate and receipt.
Fixed Worker/provider readback, hosted journey and screenshots pass.
Rollback status is explicit and source-bound if performed.

tasks.title: Retain evidence and close the deployment goal
acceptance: Sanitised receipts and current documentation agree.
The final report lists exact IDs, URLs, checks, limits and recovery ownership.
